title: "R Notebook"
output: html_notebook

## Overview

This document compares Relative Sea Level (RSL) estimates and rates from 2 models
(Test 1 and Test 2). It produces:

- RSL estimates
- RSL differences
- RSL rates
- Rate differences

---

## Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

source("R/F_differences.R")
```

## User Settings

**This is the only section you normally edit**

```{r}
# Model 1

ref_label1 <- "Test 1" # change if you wish"
ref_dir1   <- "Test 1"


# Model 2

ref_label2 <- "Test 2" # change if you wish"
ref_dir2   <- "Test 2"

# Directories

results_dir <- "results"
model_dir   <- "modeloutput"

# Save figures to disk?

save_plots <- TRUE

```


## Run

**Plots and output files will be in your working directory.**

```{r, message=FALSE}
results <- run_rsl_test()
```
